title: Skyline Ignition
description: A big-room festival EDM track in E minor at 128 BPM, 136 bars (4 minutes 15): intro, build-up with riser and snare roll, drop, breakdown, second build-up, second drop with a harmonised hook, outro. Deep sine kick, sub and offbeat bass, supersaw chords and hook, kick-sidechained pumping. Checked on paper and by measurement only; not listened to.
